dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: But alas! The Master was stricken down with disease, never again to hold his sword. The Guhua Clan, now leaderless and helpless, was henceforth laid low...

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: What a pity! What a shame! A gallant company of heroes, washed away by the cruel tide of fate!
